sentences.say: Meet Maya. She runs a small online shop that sells handmade clay mugs and pots.
sentences.caption: Meet Maya. She runs a small online shop that sells handmade clay mugs and pots.

sentences.say: More and more shoppers now ask an AI assistant to buy things for them.
sentences.caption: More and more shoppers now ask an AI assistant to buy things for them.

sentences.say: The assistant compares shops, and picks just one.
sentences.caption: The assistant compares shops, and picks just one.

sentences.say: Maya has no way to know if it was her, or why it wasn't.
sentences.caption: Maya has no way to know if it was her, or why it wasn't.

sentences.say: ChosenOne is a dashboard for shop owners like Maya, built on PayPal.
sentences.caption: ChosenOne: a dashboard for small shop owners, built on PayPal.

sentences.say: It shows how often AI shopping agents pick your shop, and why they don't.
sentences.caption: It shows how often AI shopping agents pick your shop, and why they don't.

sentences.say: Then it helps you fix it, and proves the result with real sales.
sentences.caption: Then it helps you fix it, and proves the result with real sales.

sentences.say: Here is Maya's dashboard. We ran twenty AI shoppers, each with a real request, like a dishwasher safe mug as a birthday gift.
sentences.caption: 20 AI shoppers, each with a real request.

sentences.say: Each one compared Maya's shop with competitors, and bought from one store, or none.
sentences.caption: Each compares Maya's shop with competitors and buys from one store, or none.

sentences.say: The score is called Pick Rate. Before any fixes, Maya was picked only fifteen percent of the time.
sentences.caption: PickRate before fixes: 15%

sentences.say: Why did Maya lose? The dashboard lists every lost sale, in the shopper's own words.
sentences.caption: Every lost sale, in the shopper's own words.

sentences.say: One shopper wanted food safe clay cups, and said: no statement of food safety.
sentences.caption: "No statement of food safety for the clay cups"

sentences.say: Maya knew they were safe. But that fact was only in her private notes, not on the product page.
sentences.caption: The fact was only in Maya's private notes, not on the product page.

sentences.say: Every lost sale also comes with a suggested action.
sentences.caption: Every lost sale comes with a suggested action.

sentences.say: So the AI reads Maya's own notes, and drafts the missing facts for each product.
sentences.caption: The AI drafts missing facts from Maya's own notes.

sentences.say: Every fact must quote her notes. The code checks the quote, and every number, so nothing is made up.
sentences.caption: Every fact quotes her notes. Code checks the quote and the numbers.

sentences.say: Prices and stock are never touched. Maya approves two hundred and sixty seven facts across her twenty four products.
sentences.caption: 267 facts approved across 24 products. Prices and stock never change.

sentences.say: Then we ran the same twenty shoppers again.
sentences.caption: Same 20 shoppers, run again.

sentences.say: Maya's Pick Rate jumped from fifteen percent to sixty percent. Ten sales won back.
sentences.caption: PickRate: 15% to 60%. Ten sales won back.

sentences.say: Eight are still lost, for reasons only Maya can fix, like not shipping to Canada.
sentences.caption: 8 still lost: reasons only Maya can fix, like shipping to Canada.

sentences.say: This is a small simulated test, so it shows the method, not a guarantee.
sentences.caption: A small simulated test: it shows the method, not a guarantee.

sentences.say: Now the real proof. An AI shopping agent named Chitti buys from Maya's shop.
sentences.caption: Now a real AI agent buys from Maya's shop.

sentences.say: It talks to the shop through an open standard called M C P. It searches, reads the facts and policies, and builds a cart priced by the shop.
sentences.caption: The agent searches, reads facts and policies, and builds a cart priced by the shop.

sentences.say: Then it starts a PayPal checkout, and hands the payment link to the shopper.
sentences.caption: Then it starts a PayPal checkout.

sentences.say: Here is PayPal's own checkout. The shopper logs in, chooses how to pay, and approves.
sentences.caption: PayPal's own checkout (sandbox): log in, choose how to pay, approve.

sentences.say: The payment is captured, and PayPal records which agent brought the sale.
sentences.caption: The payment is captured, and PayPal records which agent brought the sale.

sentences.say: Back in the dashboard, the order shows the agent, the amount, the PayPal capture, and a verified webhook.
sentences.caption: Agent, amount, PayPal capture and a verified webhook.

sentences.say: So Maya can finally see which AI agents bring her sales.
sentences.caption: Maya can finally see which AI agents bring her sales.

sentences.say: ChosenOne. Measure, fix, prove. Built on PayPal orders, webhooks and the Store Sync cart A P I, with Gemini and Groq free tiers.
sentences.caption: ChosenOne: Measure. Fix. Prove.

sentences.say: It's open source, and live now.
sentences.caption: Open source and live now.
